method: Manual selection of actual straight green bottom-frame segments; per-column opaque lower boundary at alpha32/128/230, robust iterated linear least squares. Report alpha128; compare threshold sensitivity. No rotation/skew/resample/art edits.

selection.description: Lower opaque silhouette of the manually selected straight green base-frame segment, excluding corner posts; no roof/counter/BBox fitting.
